get.description: Requires invoices.read, a right this module declares; by default the same built-in roles carry it as carry orders.read. There are no filters and no search: the query is the whole table, newest id first. An invoice is found from its order, not by its number. The seller name, address and tax ID printed on a plain invoice come from the invoices module's configuration in the store's own main() and have no API. A store in India whose profile has a GSTIN and sells in INR issues GST tax invoices instead, and their supplier comes from the store profile.

Requires invoices.read, a right this module declares; by default the same built-in roles carry it as carry orders.read. The document embeds the buyer's name, email and address, so it is personal data exactly as the order is. Returns a complete, self-contained printable HTML document by default, and JSON when the Accept header contains application/json. The JSON branch returns money as {amount_minor, currency}, like every other response.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The ORDER's id, not the invoice's. The list row carries both.

200.description: The invoice, as a document or as data.

get.summary: A period's GST tax invoices as TallyPrime import XML
get.description: Requires invoices.read. Only on a store that issues GST tax invoices; any other store answers 404. Reads the issued documents and nothing else: no tax is recomputed. part=ledgers is the masters (each registered buyer once, named legal name plus GSTIN, and the sales, tax, delivery and unregistered-buyer ledgers the vouchers name); part=vouchers is one Sales voucher per invoice, REMOTEID gocommerce:<store>:<invoice number>, in date then number order. Import the ledgers first. Amounts are rupees with two decimals, a debit negative, and each voucher's entries sum to zero. The file is UTF-8 with every character outside ASCII written as a numeric character reference. Agent keys are refused: the file names buyers and their addresses.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first invoice date, inclusive, on the store's clock.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last invoice date, inclusive. Less than a year after from.

200.description: Tally's Import Data envelope, as an attachment named tally-<part>-<from>-<to>.xml.

get.summary: The ledger names the Tally export uses
get.description: Requires invoices.read. Only on a store that issues GST tax invoices; any other store answers 404, which is how the panel knows to offer the export. A store that never saved names reads the defaults.

put.summary: Set the ledger names the Tally export uses
put.description: Requires invoices.configure, which by default only managers carry. The fields sent replace the saved ones and the rest are kept. Each name is trimmed, at most 100 characters, with no control characters; every one but company_name is required.

InvoicesTallyLedgers.description: Ledger names in the accountant's TallyPrime company. Defaults: Sales, CGST, SGST, UTGST, IGST, Delivery Charges, Cash Sales (the party for unregistered buyers, under Sundry Debtors) and the voucher type Sales.

company_name.description: The Tally company to import into (SVCURRENTCOMPANY); empty imports into the open one.

sales_per_rate.description: One sales ledger per rate, the rate appended: Sales 18%.

freight.description: The delivery charge's ledger, under Sales Accounts.

InvoicesSummary.description: A row in the invoice list. Prefixed with the module's own name, as every component a fragment owns must be: a duplicate component name is a boot failure in a store that installs two modules, not a test failure in either.

order_id.description: The order this invoice was issued for — the id the document route takes.

number.description: The printed invoice number, sequential and gapless within its year.

total.description: An object, not a scalar: {amount_minor, currency}.

kind.description: Present only on a GST tax invoice.

InvoicesTaxInvoice.description: A GST tax invoice (CGST Rules 2017, rule 46) as it was issued, present only for a GST store's invoices. Built once from what checkout charged and never recomputed. Every *_minor is an integer in currency. Per line, cgst + sgst + igst is the tax checkout charged and taxable + tax = total; the line totals sum to the order total. Within a state CGST is the floor of half the tax and SGST (or UTGST, when supply.state_tax_name says so) the rest; between states and for exports all of it is IGST. Delivery is an untaxed freight line with the freight_untaxed warning; cash on delivery's extra charge is an untaxed charge line.

date.description: On the store's clock, India's by default.

place_of_supply_code.description: The two-digit GST state code; 96 for a delivery outside India.

hsn.description: The variant's HS code at issue; empty with an hsn_missing warning.

rate_bp.description: The rate checkout charged. Half of it is the CGST and SGST rate, which may be a fraction of a basis point.
